title: Chiefs' Week 1 matchup not a hint about Patrick Mahomes' health, Andy Reid says

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chiefs' Week 1 matchup not a hint about Patrick Mahomes' health, Andy Reid says
sources.description: The Chiefs are playing on 'Monday Night Football' in Week 1, but Andy Reid insists that isn't a hint about Patrick Mahomes' rehab from a knee injury.
